title: We Are Men
premise_summary: We Are Men is an American sitcom television series created by Rob Greenberg starring Christopher Nicholas Smith, Tony Shalhoub, Jerry O'Connell, Kal Penn, and Rebecca Breeds. The series aired on CBS as part of the 2013–14 American television season, and premiered on September 30, 2013. On October 9, 2013, after the airing of two episodes, which performed poorly, CBS cancelled the series.
